title: Bitcoin on course to end seven-week losing streak while trailing stock rebound
content: Bitcoin (BTC) has risen 1.8% since midnight UTC to around $61,600 and is on course to end seven straight weekly losses.

title: Live news: Bitcoin rebounds above $61,000 as AI stocks lead premarket gains
content: Nasdaq 100 futures rose 3% ahead of Friday’s shortened U.S. trading session, with AI cloud stocks up 8% and silver jumping 7%.

title: Next ECB chief favors tokenized bank deposits over stablecoins and bitcoin
content: Pablo Hernández de Cos, chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde, favors blockchain-based banking and has warned against private digital currencies and banks holding bitcoin.

title: Injective asks SEC to allow order books for tokenized stock trading
content: The regulator's rules favor one type of blockchain trading system, leaving platforms built on Injective out, the developer said. It wants the SEC to open stock trading to order-book systems.

title: Brazil’s stock exchange teams up with major banks to launch real-pegged stablecoin
content: Banco B3 will issue the token, backed one-to-one by reais, and other financial institutions can join from launch.

title: Bitcoin supply metric hits 11-year low as new ‘capitulation’ signal arrives
content: The seven-day moving average of Bitcoin’s supply profit/loss ratio hit an 11-year low as BTC price losses month-to-date remain near 20%.

title: Bluefin to shut down perps, refocus on spot trading and tokenized RWAs
content: Bluefin will close its perps platform on Dec. 4, exiting a shrinking Sui market where it once handled over $500 million in daily trades.

title: ESMA to overhaul EU’s MiCA crypto register in 2027
content: ESMA’s new MiCA register will replace manual reporting and introduce automated data checks and a version history for crypto white papers.

title: New York AG secures $1.37B court judgment against NovaTech founders
content: The judgment follows an August 2025 default ruling against the founders over a Ponzi scheme that targeted Haitian and other immigrant communities.

title: Kalshi Courts Small Businesses With 'Microinsurance' as State Crackdowns Bite
content: Kalshi says about 500 businesses have used it to hedge risks such as tariffs and bad weather, as legal fights weigh on its sports markets.

title: Ethereum Sets December 15 Date for Delayed Glamsterdam Testnet Upgrade
content: Core developers will ship Glamsterdam's contested gas changes unaltered, after security concerns halted the Hoodi fork in October.

title: Vibecoded GTA 6 PC Ports Are Now Rendering In-Game Graphics Despite Take-Two Crackdown
content: Some unofficial ports now hit around 20 frames per second, as developers move their work into private communities to dodge takedowns.

title: What Is Self-Custody? How to Hold Your Own Crypto Keys
content: Self-custody means holding your own crypto instead of trusting an exchange. Here's how it works, the wallets involved and the risks.

title: Before the Sell-Off, AI Stocks Showed Dot-Com-Level Bubble Signals: Study
content: A study of 170 years of financial journalism suggests AI stocks rivaled dot-com bubble levels, but estimates vary.
